content.short: Reax is a full-stack synthetics protocol on Mantle with a slippage-free DEX, perpetuals, lending, vaults, and a launchpad for 200+ assets.
content.description: Reax is a comprehensive DeFi protocol on Mantle built around synthetic assets, enabling trading of over 200 real-world and crypto assets through a slippage-free model powered by an oracle-based pricing engine. Beyond the DEX, Reax offers perpetual futures, a lending market, yield vaults, and a token launchpad  making it an all-in-one DeFi platform for Mantle users. The synthetic model eliminates slippage entirely, providing a unique trading experience compared to traditional AMMs.
